params.message:
The report reader goes to any page from the track under it

The reader moved one page at a time, back or forward, and the line under the page only
showed how far along it was. Reaching the source list at the back of a 28-page report
took 27 presses. The line is now one mark per page: the marks up to the open page are
filled, a mark takes the reader to its page, and the page a mark stands for is named
above the track while the pointer or the focus is on it.

Portal: In de leesweergave van een rapport kan je onderaan rechtstreeks naar elke pagina springen.
